subject.name: Substation Engineering and Power Quality
subject.source: Syllabus/Diploma_Full_Collection_1/Marwadi_Official_Diploma_Collector/Marwadi_Diploma_Syllabus_Collection/Verified_Syllabi/Diploma Electrical Engineering/Semester_Unspecified/09EE2602 - Department Elective – II Substation Engineering and Power Quality.pdf

content: Construction and single line diagram of substation
discharge, PD monitoring strategies, CB monitoring, local
type tests, routine tests, on-site field tests
measurement of loss and temperature rise
Introduction of electrode and earth mat
Connections of electrical equipment to station earthing
Measurement of step potential and touch potential
Causes and effect of power quality problems, Transients
Impulsive, Oscillatory, short duration and long duration
Analyzers, Transient disturbance analyzers, Power line
disturbance analyzer, Flicker meters, Oscilloscopes, True
Numbers of test locations and test duration
IEEE and IEC standard for power quality
Voltage sag, due to starting of induction motor
Voltage tolerance criteria: CBEMA and ITIC curves
Examples of transient models and their response
Lightning protection, shielding, line arresters, protection
Concept of harmonics, harmonics number, odd and even
order harmonics, inter harmonics, harmonic phase
Effect of harmonics on power system equipment: motors
Guidelines for harmonics voltage and current limitation
Harmonic current mitigation techniques: harmonic filter
Improvement and correction of power factor
